title: Archive Governance Audit — Section F Clones (Pack C + Pack D)

clone_groups.discrepancy: Agent J found 17 unique stem skeletons (company-name normalized) vs Agent B's 14 clone groups. This discrepancy must be resolved before executing archival. Possible explanations: (a) 3 of the 17 skeletons represent the 5 standalone unique items with related subtopics, (b) Agent B's group-merging methodology differs, (c) some groups have non-standard membership counts.
clone_groups.resolution_required: Before executing writes, confirm whether 14 or 15-17 groups exist. The archive count (56 vs 58-60) depends on this.

pack_c_f.rotation_evidence: Group 1 (001-004): data governance with company names Brightpoint→Cedarline→Driftwood→Emberton, CC rotation B→C→D→A. Identical stem skeleton across all members.

pack_d_f.dl008_detail: P1-FD-044 (CC=B, EW_B non-empty: 'Choice B is incorrect because digital signatures authenticate the signer\'s identity...'). This item is proposed for archival — EW_B text describes the correct distractor feedback but is misplaced in the CC slot.
pack_d_f.pre_archived_item: P1-FD-046 is already Archived (State: Archived, CC=C, Topic: master data management). Agent B identified this as anomalous — it was likely manually archived as a quality-control action rather than part of a batch operation. If 046 is a seed in its clone group, it should be unarchived (→Unprocessed) to serve as the group's active seed.

archived_valid_state.evidence: QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.1: question_state values include 'Archived'. §9.2: 'Any State → Archived: consolidation or removal from active pool'. §9.2 Rule 3: 'Archival preserves content. Archived questions retain full question text and metadata. Only the state field changes.'

seeds_preserved.detail: Per DL-012 pattern: 1 seed per clone group remains active (Unprocessed). For P1-FD-046 (already Archived): either (a) unarchive it to serve as group seed, or (b) designate another QID in the same group (047-050) as the seed. Must be verified per-group before execution.

no_certified_removed.evidence: Pack C Section F: 0/75 Certified. Pack D Section F: 0/75 Certified. All items are Unprocessed (74) or Archived (1). Zero learner-pool impact.

content_preserved.evidence: Archived state preserves all content per §9.2 Rule 3. Only question_state field changes from 'Unprocessed' to 'Archived'. Deletion is not performed.

batch_plan.plan: 4 batches per Agent B proposal: Pack C (2 × 28 = 56), Pack D (28 + 27 = 55). All ≤28 per batch, compliant with governance-guard Rule 5.
batch_plan.alternative_if_more_groups: If Agent J's 17-group finding is correct, archives increase to ~58 Pack C + ~59 Pack D = ~117 items → 5 batches (28+28+28+28+5). This is also compliant with Rule 5.

governance_checks.expected_state_change: Unprocessed → Archived (or possibly 'Unprocessed → Archived' with P1-FD-046 'Archived → Unprocessed' fix)

governance_guard_review.rule_2_dl008_block: NO BLOCK — archival writes only change question_state, they do NOT introduce new ExplanationWrong content. P1-FD-044's DL-008 is pre-existing and would be preserved (not introduced by the write). The write operation does not match the findDL008Violations check since it changes state only.
governance_guard_review.rule_3_registry_block: NO BLOCK — not writing to MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md
governance_guard_review.rule_5_batch_block: COMPLIANT — batches ≤28 items each. BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker recommended in the write content.
governance_guard_review.rule_1_revision_warn: WILL TRIGGER WARNING (expected) — question_state changes require REVISION_HISTORY.md update. This is WARN only (not BLOCK). The revision entry MUST be written contemporaneously.
governance_guard_review.rule_4_answer_key_warn: NO TRIGGER — no CorrectChoice or answer-key changes.

risk_assessment.learner_pool_impact: ZERO — all 111 items are Unprocessed (or already Archived), never delivered to learners
risk_assessment.certification_regression: NONE — 0 Certified items affected across both packs
risk_assessment.blueprint_gap_risk: LOW — seeds preserved (1 per clone group). Section F remains represented by unique stem-topics.

risk_assessment.dl008_risk_on_p1_fd_044: LOW — P1-FD-044's DL-008 is pre-existing. Archival preserves the defect but does not introduce it. The item was never Certified, so the DL-008 has zero learner exposure. Can be remediated in a future session without urgency.

verdict_caveats: CAVEAT 1: Clone group count discrepancy (14 per Agent B vs 17 stem skeletons per Agent J). Resolve before executing writes — verify the exact group boundaries and seed designations per QID. The archive count may be 56/55 (if 14 groups) or 58/60+ (if 15-17 groups). Either count is ≤28 per batch under Rule 5.

CAVEAT 2: P1-FD-046 is already Archived. Determine whether it serves as a seed (unarchive it → Unprocessed) or whether another group member should be designated as seed. If unarchiving, add it to the write plan.
CAVEAT 3: P1-FD-044 has DL-008 (EW_B non-empty when CC=B). Pre-existing defect, not introduced by archival. Document in REVISION_HISTORY.md entry.

CAVEAT 4: P1-FC-075 stem extraction returned 'undefined' in Agent J's block parser. Verify the item is complete before archiving — its ExplanationWrong fields are present and question_state is 'Unprocessed'.
CAVEAT 5: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry REQUIRED per governance-guard Rule 1. Write contemporaneously with each batch. Do not batch entries — one entry per batch with QID lists.
